label: PREBUILT TEST DOUBLES, UNCERTIFIED
statement: These are test doubles for external protocols, used only by make quick so the sandbox story runs without Rust. They were built with cargo-near's reproducible-wasm command inside the pinned image named in toolchain.image, from a clean clone at source.revision, so they embed no path of the building machine (only the image's /home/near paths and the repository URL in the NEP-330 metadata). Two builds from two independent clean clones at that revision produced identical bytes (reproduction). make quick never rebuilds them: it checks these pinned hashes only, so a quick run certifies nothing. make test and make demo build the stubs from source and are the certified path. The mandate make quick deploys is the reproducible deployment candidate fixtures/deploy/bounded_mandate-163ccfa-reproducible.wasm, not a file in this directory.
build_command: cargo near build reproducible-wasm --manifest-path stubs/<crate>/Cargo.toml --out-dir <dir> (host cargo-near 0.22.0, Docker 29.9.2, clean git clone at source.revision)

mock_ft.wasm.role: Test double NEP-141 token; deployed twice as the USDC and wNEAR test tokens

mock_oracle.wasm.role: Test double of aggregate-oracle.near: operator-set prices; never oracle output

mock_mpc.wasm.role: Test double of the MPC signer v1.signer: signs with deterministic Ed25519 TEST keys anyone can recompute; never MPC output

reproduction.method: two independent `git clone` copies of the product repository checked out at source.revision; each crate built once per clone with build_command; sha256 compared
reproduction.no_machine_paths: strings(1) over each WASM finds no /Users/ path and no absolute path of the building checkout; the only absolute paths are /home/near/... from the image
